oidc.note: the cluster trusts no identity provider: this server knows no audience the installation's apiserver accepts, so calls to the cluster as you are refused as Unauthorized — pass global.controlPlane.oidc in values to name one

files.content:
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: gazelle-clusters-dev01
  namespace: default
spec:
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-keys
  interval: 1m
  path: ./management-clusters/gazelle/organizations/acme/workload-clusters/dev01
  prune: true
  serviceAccountName: automation
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: workload-clusters-fleet
  timeout: 2m

apiVersion: v1
data:
  values.yaml: |
    global:
      metadata:
        description: Acme's development cluster
        name: dev01
        organization: acme
      providerSpecific:
        awsClusterRoleIdentityName: acme-dev
      release:
        version: 36.0.0
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: cluster-manager
    app.kubernetes.io/name: release-aws
    giantswarm.io/cluster: dev01
    giantswarm.io/organization: acme
  name: dev01-values
  namespace: org-acme

apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: OCIRepository
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: cluster-manager
    app.kubernetes.io/name: release-aws
    giantswarm.io/cluster: dev01
    giantswarm.io/organization: acme
  name: dev01
  namespace: org-acme
spec:
  interval: 10m
  ref:
    tag: 36.0.0
  url: oci://gsoci.azurecr.io/charts/giantswarm/release-aws
---
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: cluster-manager
    app.kubernetes.io/name: release-aws
    giantswarm.io/cluster: dev01
    giantswarm.io/organization: acme
  name: dev01
  namespace: org-acme
spec:
  chartRef:
    kind: OCIRepository
    name: dev01
  install:
    remediation:
      retries: 3
  interval: 10m
  releaseName: dev01
  serviceAccountName: automation
  upgrade:
    remediation:
      retries: 3
  valuesFrom:
  - kind: ConfigMap
    name: cluster-app-installation-values
    valuesKey: values.yaml
  - kind: ConfigMap
    name: dev01-values
    valuesKey: values.yaml

apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - dev01-values.yaml
  - dev01.yaml

apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - wc1.yaml
  - dev01.yaml
